subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical Google Chat Space @mention drop bug after the shipped classifier fix, or should maintainers consolidate the remaining work into a broader Google Chat Space routing item?
rationale: Source review proves the classifier portion is shipped and the mention gate can still skip accepted Space events, but choosing the owner boundary affects whether the fix is a narrow plugin bug, a diagnostics/setup improvement, or part of broader Space/thread routing work.

options.title: Keep Narrow Mention-Gate Bug
options.body: Keep this issue open for live Space @mention proof and a focused Google Chat plugin fix or diagnostic improvement.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining work into the broader Google Chat Space/thread routing discussion if maintainers want one canonical Space reliability effort.

options.title: Treat Current Workaround As Enough
options.body: Close only after maintainers confirm that configured `botUser` or `requireMention: false` is the supported outcome and no current Space @mention bug remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Mention-Gate Bug
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for live Space @mention proof and a focused Google Chat plugin fix or diagnostic improvement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Google Chat monitor, access policy, and threading files that define the remaining owner boundary.
